page.layout: One page of text, a printed table of contents in one column. Top: heading "LOCORUM ET QUAESTIONUM." with subheadings and question lines, each with page numbers at the right. Below a horizontal rule: the division heading "LOCUS VICESIMUS DE NOVISSIMIS", a subtitle, and further question lines with page numbers. Bottom right: catchword "DE". No margin notes, no running head, no page number.

main_text.head: LOCORUM ET QUAESTIONUM.
DE PRAESENTIA CORPORALI CHRISTI IN COENA, ET ORALI EJUS MANDUCATIONE.
main_text.l: QUAESTIO XXVIII. An Christus praesens sit corporaliter in Eucharistia, & An oraliter manducetur à fidelibus? Neg.cont.Pont.& Lutheran. pag. 565
main_text.head: DE SACRIFICIO MISSATICO.
main_text.l: Q. XXIX. An in Eucharistia offeratur Deo externum, reale, & proprie dictum Sacrificium, non laudis tantùm, gratiarum actionis, commemorationis, sed verè propitiatorium pro peccatis vivorum & mortuorum? Neg. cont. Pontif. 582
main_text.head: DE ADORATIONE EUCHARISTIÆ.
main_text.l: Q. XXX. An Cultus Latriæ seu Adoratio debeatur Sacramento Eucharistiæ? Neg. cont. Pontif. 602
main_text.head: DE QUINQUE FALSIS PONTIFICIORUM SACRAMENTIS.
main_text.l: Q. XXXI. An Confirmatio, Pœnitentia, Ordo, Matrimonium & Extrema Unctio sint vera Sacramenta? Neg. cont. Pont. 614
main_text.head: LOCUS VICESIMUS DE NOVISSIMIS.
DE RESURRECTIONE MORTUORUM.
main_text.l: QUAESTIO I. An futura sit Mortuorum resurrectio novissimo die? Affirm. 628
Q. II. An eadem numero Corpora, quæ mortua sunt, resurrectura sint? Affir. cont. Socin. 639
Q. III. An præter universalem Resurrectionem detur particularis Sanctorum, vel Martyrum, quæ mille annis ultimam præcessura sit? Neg. 643
main_text.head: DE CONSUMMATIONE SECULI.
main_text.l: Q. IV. An certi aliquid & determinati haberi possit de tempore Consummationis seculi? & An signa quædam eam præcedere debeant? Prius Neg. Poster. Affir. 652
Q. V. Qualis futurus sit Mundi interitus? An per ultimam conflagrationem sit annihilandus, An verò instaurandus & renovandus? 660
main_text.head: DE JUDICIO EXTREMO.
main_text.l: Q. VI. An Judicium Extremum expectandum sit, & quale illud sit futurum? 667

page.notes: The page numbers 565, 582, 602, 614, 628, 639, 643, 652, 660, 667 are printed at the line ends and kept in their lines. The heading "LOCUS VICESIMUS DE NOVISSIMIS." is set in large type across two lines, with the rule above it, and is one heading. The large initial Q of "QUAESTIO I." is joined to the word. The "Q" of the lines before XXIX and XXX has a decorative flourish, read as Q. Some letters are blurred in the scan (e.g. "propitiatorium", "Eucharistiae"), but they appear clear enough to read.
